What is Zoiko Rooms?
Zoiko Rooms is a global platform exclusively for private individual rooms rented for 30 nights or longer. It helps room seekers review evidence-specific room information, confirm who is authorized to offer the room, communicate safely, complete the appropriate rental process and maintain a clear transaction record through move-out.
What accommodation is available?
Private individual rooms within larger residential properties. Whole homes, hotels, dormitory beds and nightly vacation rentals are outside the core scope.

Room Passport
The record that tells you what's actually true about a room.
Every room on Zoiko Rooms carries a Room Passport — a structured, evidence-scoped record of what's been declared, documented, or physically inspected, kept current from first listing to move-out.
List Your Room
How Verification Works
Scroll
A listing is a claim. A Room Passport is the evidence behind it.
Photos and a price are not enough to know whether a room exists, whether the person offering it is entitled to, or whether what you're seeing is current. Room Passport separates the two: what the provider says, and what's actually been checked.
"Verified" is not one word doing the work of ten different checks. It's ten separate, dated, sourced answers.
That's the whole idea. Not a badge. A record.

A More Trusted Way to Rent a Room
Zoiko Rooms is a global technology platform dedicated exclusively to individual rooms for rent, generally for 30 consecutive nights or longer, supporting the journey from discovery and verification through agreement, payment and move-out where the relevant services are available.
We help people find, assess, secure and manage private rooms with greater clarity. We also help homeowners, landlords, authorized tenants, professional operators, universities, employers, healthcare organizations and relocation providers offer or manage rooms through structured, accountable workflows.

Vision
A world in which people can secure a suitable room without depending on incomplete listings, unverifiable claims or unsafe informal transactions.

The Problem
Why Zoiko Rooms Exists
Individual rooms are essential housing infrastructure. People use them to study, relocate for work, begin a new career, reduce housing costs, complete a project, move after a life transition or establish themselves in a new city or country.
Yet the category remains fragmented. A listing may be published in minutes, while the most important questions are left for strangers to resolve privately.
Common market failures
Non-existent rooms, copied photographs, duplicate listings, hidden household conditions, unauthorized subletting and providers who cannot demonstrate authority.
Transaction failures
Inappropriate agreements, unclear fees, unprotected payments, weak move-in evidence, discrimination, harassment and limited support after occupancy begins.

Fair Housing & Anti-Discrimination
Everyone should be able to explore housing opportunities on Zoiko Rooms without unlawful discrimination.
We prohibit discriminatory conduct in housing-related listings, communications, access, screening, terms, and platform activity, subject to applicable law and legitimate jurisdiction-specific exceptions.

What is Zoiko Rooms' Fair Housing & Anti-Discrimination policy?
Zoiko Rooms prohibits discrimination that unlawfully or unfairly restricts access to housing opportunities on the platform. The policy applies to listings, communications, viewings, applications, screening, rental terms, accessibility, and other housing-related activity, with local legal requirements applied through jurisdiction-specific rules.

01 / Core Principles
Our Fair Housing Commitment
Equal Access
Housing opportunities should not be hidden, withheld, or made materially harder to access because of a protected or policy-protected characteristic.
Consistent Criteria
Providers should apply legitimate eligibility criteria consistently to similarly situated applicants.
Accurate Information
Availability, pricing, requirements, and property information should be communicated accurately and consistently.
No Steering

No Steering
Do not direct, discourage, or channel people toward or away from particular housing opportunities for discriminatory reasons.
Accessibility

Accountability
Discrimination reports are reviewed under applicable policy, evidence, and law, with proportionate action where warranted.
02 / Defining Discrimination
What Discrimination Can Look Like
Discrimination can include treating someone less favorably, imposing different conditions, making housing unavailable, discouraging access, or applying a rule that unlawfully disadvantages a protected group.
Protected Categories:

title: Fair Housing & Anti-Discrimination Policy | Zoiko Rooms

conditions, making housing unavailable, discouraging access, or applying a rule that unlawfully disadvantages a protected group.
Protected Categories:
Zoiko Rooms does not allow discrimination based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partnership status, family or familial status, lawful source of income or receipt of benefits where protected, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Local rules and lawful exceptions may differ.
Examples of Prohibited Conduct
Refusing to provide property information, a viewing, or an application opportunity for a discriminatory reason.
Falsely stating that a room is unavailable to discourage a person because of a protected characteristic.
Applying different deposits, fees, rent, rules, screening thresholds, or tenancy terms for discriminatory reasons.

Deliberately steering people toward or away from locations based on protected characteristics.
Ignoring a legally required accommodation or adjustment process.

Zoiko Rooms operates primarily as a rooms and shared-housing marketplace. Because sharing a dwelling involves close personal cohabitation, some jurisdictions recognize distinct rules regarding roommate selection and preferences where residents share primary living areas.

Our Community Principles
Every interaction on Zoiko Rooms should be built around respect, honesty, safety, privacy, fairness, and accountability.
Respect
Treat people, their homes, property, and communities with dignity.
Honesty
Provide accurate information and communicate truthfully.
Safety
Do not put another person, property, or community at unreasonable risk.
Fairness
Treat people fairly and follow applicable housing and anti-discrimination requirements.
Privacy
Respect personal information, boundaries, communications, and consent.
Accountability

Section 03
Be Honest and Accurate
Trust begins before a renter and provider meet. Material information supplied through Zoiko Rooms must not be intentionally false, deceptive, or materially misleading.
Providers must not misrepresent:
Real physical location
Rent, utility, and extra charges
Fresh, correct availability dates
Room type, size, and photos
Exact room amenities & conditions
Applicable house rules
True provider identity
Verified accessibility features
Renters must not misrepresent:
Material information in registration, applications, background referencing checks, guarantor details, identity documents, or employment claims.
Prohibited Deception
Never falsify documents, identities, property information, eligibility information, verification evidence, or transaction records.

Section 04
Keep People Safe
We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for behaviors that compromise the physical safety or security of people, properties, or community neighborhoods.
The following safety risks are strictly prohibited:
Credible threats of violence or intentional property damage
Deliberate physical harm, abuse, or endangerment of any person
Coercion, human exploitation, or forced labor of any kind
Dangerous interference with home safety equipment (smoke detectors, fire escapes)
Creation of serious property hazards (unaddressed structural, electrical, or biological dangers)
Human trafficking or coordinating any serious unlawful platform activity

Respect personal information, private communications, physical boundaries, and mutual platform consent.

Publish other users' private contact, financial, or personal information

Use Zoiko Rooms Responsibly
Platform systems must not be used to deceive users, manipulate platform signals, commit fraud, interfere with service integrity, or bypass legitimate safeguards.

Artificial account creation or synthetic inquiry activity.
Unauthorized automated access, crawling, or systematic scraping of platform data.
Deliberate circumvention of safety controls, booking flows, or payment protections.

Respect Homes and Communities
Rooms exist within homes, buildings, shared spaces, and communities. Users must respect disclosed and lawful property conditions and the rights and safety of others.
Respect disclosed occupancy limits and stay boundaries unconditionally.
Observe reasonable, disclosed house rules, shared area guidelines, and noise schedules.
Use shared spaces, appliances, and common amenities responsibly and with cleanliness.
Avoid intentional or reckless property damage, vandalism, or unauthorized alterations.

Section 10
How We Enforce These Standards
When Zoiko Rooms becomes aware of a potential violation, we may review relevant information and take proportionate action based on the circumstances, available evidence, applicable policies, contractual rights, and legal requirements.
Guidance
Education, clarification, or corrective direction regarding appropriate platform behavior.
Warning
Formal notice regarding documented conduct or direct warning about future policy expectations.
Content Action
Correction, restriction, shadow suppression, or complete removal of violating content listings.
Feature Restriction
Temporary or scoped limitation of specific platform capabilities (e.g. messaging, listing limit).
Transaction Action
Action affecting an active inquiry, room application, reservation, payment processing, or stay agreements.
Account Restriction

Account Restriction

Account Removal

Legal / Safety Escalation
External law enforcement action required by local authorities or for immediate fraud, safety, and security threats.
The action taken depends on the circumstances. Serious violations may result in immediate restrictions, suspension, removal, or escalation without prior warning where permitted.
Section 11
Request a Review (Appeals)
Where an enforcement decision is eligible for review, the affected user will be told how to request one.
Our Review Principles
Reviews are conducted strictly against the applicable platform policy framework.

Our Review Principles
Reviews are conducted strictly against the applicable platform policy framework.
Allow affected users to submit relevant additional information, missing evidence, or contextual proof.
Reduce reviewer conflicts of interest by assigning independent, un-involved trust & safety officers.
Provide a clear, written record of the review outcome and specific reasons.
Communicate the outcome transparently within a reasonable timeframe.
Note: Not every platform decision is eligible for appeal (especially those triggered by direct legal mandates).

Available methods vary by country, currency, risk, and provider. The methods offered to you at checkout are the authoritative list — we don't promise a specific card, wallet, or bank method will always be available.
Authorization and authentication
When you authorize a payment, you'll see a final amount preview before it's confirmed. Your provider or card issuer may require additional authentication — if that authentication fails, no completed payment is created; the transaction simply doesn't go through.

Saved methods and recurring mandates
If you save a payment method or set up a recurring rent schedule, you're granting standing authority to charge that method on the agreed terms. Cancelling that authority stops future charges — but it doesn't cancel amounts already due under a valid tenancy agreement; that's a separate conversation with your landlord.
Currency and conversion
The transaction currency is shown before you authorize a payment. Where Zoiko Rooms or its provider controls the conversion rate, the rate and any markup are disclosed. Where your card issuer converts the currency instead, that conversion is outside our control and subject to your issuer's own terms.

Fees, taxes & currency

Payouts to hosts
Onboarding, timing, holds, and statements for landlords and hosts.
Hosts complete identity and bank verification through our payment provider before payouts activate. Payout timing follows a disclosed processing rule — we don't guarantee arrival dates unless that's contractually promised, since bank and provider delays sit outside our control.
Payment holds
A payout or transaction may be paused for a narrow set of reasons: suspected fraud, sanctions screening, identity mismatch, an open dispute, provider review, a legal order, duplicate-payment risk, or an account security concern. A hold is a preventive pause — it doesn't change who owns the funds.

Payout statements
Each statement reconciles gross tenant payments, refunds, deposit movements, taxes, Zoiko fees, provider charges, chargebacks or reserves, and the resulting net payout. Tenant security deposits are never shown as host revenue before they're legally releasable.
When something goes wrong
Failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, and rental disputes are handled differently — on purpose.
Failed, reversed, or duplicate payments
Pending, failed, reversed, and duplicate payment states are all shown clearly with self-service status. We never ask you to pay again while an earlier attempt is still unresolved.
Refunds
Refund eligibility comes from the underlying rental or cancellation rule that applies to your booking — Payment Terms don't invent a separate payment-law cancellation right on top of that.

Changes & governing hierarchy
How updates work, and what governs if terms conflict.
Material changes to these Payment Terms get an effective date, an archived prior version, and notice or re-acceptance where required. An update can't retroactively alter a transaction you already authorized under the terms in effect at the time.
Order of precedence
Where terms conflict: your specific transaction snapshot, then mandatory market law, then your occupancy agreement, then your payment provider's or deposit scheme's terms, then these Payment Terms, then our general Terms of Use.

Press Release
Zoiko Rooms Introduces a Global Marketplace Built for Trusted Room Rentals
Sacramento, California
·
Aug 25, 2026
(
Issuewire.com
)
Zoiko Realty Group Inc., a Zoiko Group company, today announced Zoiko Rooms, its global room rental marketplace designed to make finding, securing and managing rooms more structured, transparent and accountable. Zoiko Rooms is a trading name of Zoiko Realty Group Inc.
Read the original release on Issuewire
Room rentals remain an important part of global housing supply, workforce mobility, student accommodation, relocation and flexible living. Yet the journey is often fragmented across listing sites, messaging apps, identity checks, spreadsheets, bank transfers and separate compliance records. Zoiko Rooms is designed to reduce that fragmentation by connecting discovery with the transaction and operational steps that follow.

Trust is designed into the platform architecture. Verification state, permissions, transaction status, compliance evidence and important actions are intended to form part of the underlying workflow, not simply appear as labels on a listing. Where money is involved, Zoiko Rooms is designed around authoritative transaction records to reduce ambiguity about what has been charged, paid, received, refunded or remains outstanding.

The platform uses a global core with controlled jurisdiction specific configurations. Market configurations can accommodate local housing requirements, identity processes, payment methods, currencies, taxation considerations, tenancy structures, privacy obligations, consumer disclosures and terminology without embedding one country's rules across the entire product. Availability, features and compliance capabilities will vary by jurisdiction.
Zoiko Rooms also supports distinct renter and host experiences while allowing people who perform both roles to operate through one account relationship. The objective is a focused experience for each role without creating disconnected identities or records.
